name: web-black-and-yellow-tape-marketplace-hero
title: Dark marketplace site with a yellow caution-tape ticker and condensed headlines
whatItIs: A laptop floating above a continuing screen. The dark navy hero has thin globe lines with yellow dots, a condensed white and yellow headline, small pills, a yellow CTA, and a diagonal yellow tape ticker of avatars and slogans. Below are chips of use cases and a bright yellow product block.
whatItMeans: Loud, urban and busy; yellow tape reads like a live activation.
techniques: Set a diagonal yellow tape strip as a ticker across the hero.
Use tall condensed uppercase with yellow emphasis words.
Add faint globe or network lines as a background pattern.
Pour a chip cloud of example use cases under the hero.
Let the page extend out of the laptop to show length.

vocabulary.definition: A tilted band with repeating slogans, like caution tape.
A collection of small tags showing example queries.
Fine lines suggesting a wireframe globe.
A page that continues beyond the device frame.
